targets.guidance: Publish forcing event, interval and spatial-support provenance; do not write downstream field storage or presentation state.
targets.acceptance: The same forcing support cannot be converted twice without an explicit partition or transformation boundary.

targets.guidance: Own runoff/canal derivation on declared supports and emit one directed boundary flux per transfer with volume units and one writer.
targets.acceptance: Internal transfers cancel globally while source/destination node balances close.

targets.guidance: Own field storage, serial field transfer, infiltration/evaporation/percolation and discharge as separate terms; consume upstream fluxes without re-authoring them.
targets.acceptance: Initial plus inflow minus outflow equals final storage for every field and interval.

targets.guidance: Treat wetness and water appearance as read-only presentation derived from canonical state; never insert display variables into the mass ledger.
targets.acceptance: Presentation changes cannot change physical water totals.
